instructions.introduction: Imagine you’re planning and booking a trip with an AI assistant. We’re studying which parts of the process you’d want the assistant to handle, how you want the assistant to handle them, and which parts you’d prefer to do yourself. (The AI assistant isn’t perfect and it may break sometimes…how would you like that handled?) For each task, we’ll give you the trip details and tell you what you need to prioritize, and you choose the AI response you’d prefer in that situation. The study will be broken down into three portions:

steps.title: Planning your trip:
steps.text: Here is where you will decide how you’d like to find and choose a flight, a hotel, a room and rate, and a rental car.

steps.title: Preparing your reservations:
steps.text: This is where you decide how you’d like to get the flight, hotel, and rental car reservations added to cart/ready for payment.

steps.title: Completing the purchase:
steps.text: This is where you decide how you’d want to pay for the trip.

instructions.note: First, choose flights across four budget and schedule scenarios. Then complete the remaining tasks. All travel details are fictional; you and the chatbot can search the same options. Nothing is actually reserved or paid for. Treat each task independently. Choose a chatbot approach or the Do it yourself option, or describe another approach. Click Start Study to begin.

checkpoints.title: Finding and choosing a flight

context.text: You’re flying alone from Chicago (ORD) to Boston (BOS) this Friday for a vacation. Your return flight is already arranged.
All flights are nonstop economy. Prices include taxes and one checked bag. Airlines are equally acceptable, with the same cancellation terms. Times are local: CT for departure and ET for arrival.
Preference: Save money, but you would prefer departing between 10 a.m. and noon. Choosing a flight does not reserve or purchase it.
Requirements: $350 maximum, including taxes and one checked bag. Depart Friday between 9 a.m. and noon CT.
How would you prefer to find and choose your flight?
